method: Revisable source-based assessment of the audit itself. Known issues are hypotheses to check against all supplied meaning fields, not absolute gold. No repair calls.
checks: Does independent inventory include the nonconsecutive-month rule rejected from first low leave draft, and does comparison expose its absence?
Does inventory retain teacher topic, schedule variants and qualified future-headcount example; distinguish absent extracted prose from meaning already present in explicit logic_text.
Does comparison find overbroad standalone permissions and distinguish source quotes from complete meaning, without inventing requirements?
Check paper-map non-prohibition versus permission label and whether recommendations stay recommendations.
Check complete storm conjunction and alternative record formats: false alarms must be checked against statement, scope, choice and logic fields.
Separate wrong model judgments from structural/quote/link parsing refusals; inspect raw responses as well as accepted report.
Report tokens and elapsed time for low extraction plus both audit calls; compare with saved high extraction and distinguish diagnostics from corrected output.
controls: Saved high extraction is a quality/cost reference, not a current paired model run. All four low drafts retained unchanged.
